heading: VALife basics in 69 seconds
name: VALife: the basics for veterans with a service-connected disability
description: VALife is whole life insurance from the VA for veterans with a service-connected disability rating: who can apply, the coverage amounts, and when full coverage starts, with each fact from va.gov. Honorbrook is an independent agency, not affiliated with the VA.
transcript: VALife: the basics for veterans with a service-connected disability. Who can apply, how much, and when coverage starts. Honorbrook is an independent agency, not affiliated with the VA. VA facts here come from va.gov, checked November 2026. VALife is whole life insurance from the VA. You can apply at age 80 or younger, with a service-connected disability rating. Even a 0% rating. VALife offers up to $40,000 of whole life coverage, in $10,000 steps. You do not need to prove good health. And there is no time limit to apply after you get your rating. Full coverage starts 2 years after you apply. If death happens during that wait, your beneficiaries get the premiums paid, plus interest. Want to see how VALife fits? An independent agent can show private options next to VALife, so you can compare. Want to talk it through? Schedule a time at honorbrook-insurance.com or call (301) 615-8289.
